title: Differences Between Poetry, Prose, and Drama
skills: identify structural features of each literary form
compare how literary forms organize language and ideas
analyze how form influences a reader's experience and interpretation
alignment_note: Compares poetry, prose, and drama by highlighting differences in structure, presentation, and use of language. Supports genre recognition, literary-form analysis, close reading, and comparison of how authors shape meaning through different forms across high school English courses.
